delete_documents.description: Delete documents from a MongoDB collection.
delete_documents.name: delete_documents

parameters.description: The database that contains the collection.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: Collection containing the documents to delete.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: A MongoDB query object identifying which documents to delete, e.g. {"_id": "64b0000000000000000000aa"}. Must be non-empty; to delete every document deliberately, use {"_id": {"$exists": true}}.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Set to true to delete every matching document, or false to delete only the first match.
parameters.name: many

find_documents.description: Find documents in a MongoDB collection, optionally filtered and limited.
find_documents.name: find_documents

parameters.description: The database that contains the collection.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: A MongoDB query object of the fields and values documents must match, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Leave blank to return every document. Query operators such as $gt, $in and $regex are supported.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: The maximum number of documents to return.
parameters.name: limit

documents.description: The matching documents. Each document's _id is returned as a string.

insert_documents.description: Insert one or more documents into a MongoDB collection.
insert_documents.name: insert_documents

parameters.description: The database that contains the collection.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: The collection to insert into. Pick an existing collection, or reference a name from an earlier step to create one on the fly (MongoDB creates the collection automatically on first insert).
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The documents to insert. Each item is an object of field names and values. Omit _id to let MongoDB generate one.
parameters.name: documents

inserted_ids.description: The _id of each inserted document, as strings.

update_documents.description: Update documents in a MongoDB collection.
update_documents.name: update_documents

parameters.description: The database that contains the collection.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: Collection containing the documents to update.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: A MongoDB query object identifying which documents to update, e.g. {"email": "ada@example.com"}. Must be non-empty; to update every document deliberately, use {"_id": {"$exists": true}}.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: The fields and new values to save on each matching document (applied with MongoDB's $set), e.g. {"status": "archived"}.
parameters.name: updates

parameters.description: Set to true to update every matching document, or false to update only the first match.
parameters.name: many

description: Find, insert, update, and delete documents in your MongoDB collections.
